description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPSyncStatus class, which models the synchronization status of LDAP integration within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as sync start and finish times, the user who performed the sync, and the current sync status, along with methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of an LDAP synchronization process, including timestamps, associated user, and status code.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the LDAP sync status record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the LDAP sync status record.

methods.name: getSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when LDAP sync started.

methods.name: setSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when LDAP sync started.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when LDAP sync finished.

methods.name: setSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when LDAP sync finished.

methods.name: getSyncedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the LDAP sync.

methods.name: setSyncedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the LDAP sync.

methods.name: getSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns the current LDAP sync status.

methods.name: setSyncStatus
methods.description: Sets the current LDAP sync status.
